CORRECTIONS.item: A real -1.0 is refused for CHARGE_CURRENT, CURRENT_FRONT, TORQUE_FRONT
CORRECTIONS.detail: DiagnosticExtra.decode drops 0xBF800000 for every float; for these converters wire 4990/9990/4990 legitimately give -1.0 (research: 'Legitimate API-1 collides with the float fallback'). For the pack current read the raw alias 1009/0xC4400018 (float32(wire)) and compute wire*0.1-500 in the app: -1.0 is then unambiguous. No raw alias is known for the front drive.
AC_TEMP_OUT follows AC_TEMPERATURE_UNIT 1000/0x40400027 (1 °C, 0 °F; live 1). Add that GET and show «н/д» (or convert) when 0; the stock Celsius domain is -40..50, the product range -39..150.
ENGINE_STATE 1012/0x10D00038 is a 3-bit field; stock gbacqservice treats only 3 as running. Product uses >= 1 (works because only 0/3 were seen). Prefer == 3 with «код N» for 1/2/4-7.

CORRECTIONS.item: Rear torque/current/rpm ranges imply a sign the field does not have
CORRECTIONS.detail: 2850002C/3C and 28500178/88 are unsigned16*0.1, 0FC000D0/E0 unsigned16: a negative (regen/reverse) cannot appear; a two's-complement wrap would read 3276.8+ and pass the ±5000/±2000 gates. Tighten to 0..3000 (torque/current) so a wrap is «н/д», and check the sign live during regen.
